{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The nature and substance of each goal — what it aims to improve, how, at what scope, and how well-specified/actionable it is — i.e., characterizing goals to identify which merit attention.",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "goal_outcome_domain", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Classifies the substantive outcome area of the goal, a core facet of what the goal is about."},
    {"name": "improvement_mechanism", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures the 'how' — the lever used to achieve the goal, a coherent facet of goal substance."},
    {"name": "targeted_improvement_scope", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Identifies the specific object being improved; complements outcome domain, though partially redundant with it (parallel value counts)."},
    {"name": "implementation_timeline_clarity", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Measures specificity of timing, a well-specification facet relevant to whether a goal is actionable/worth attention."},
    {"name": "financial_impact_quantified", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Flags whether financial impact is quantified — a facet of goal rigor/attention-worthiness."},
    {"name": "goal_scope_breadth", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Distinguishes single-function vs enterprise-wide reach, a meaningful facet of goal significance."},
    {"name": "execution_complexity_estimate", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Estimates difficulty of execution, directly relevant to what merits attention and risk."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.85,
  "structure_quality": 0.8,
  "focus_actionability": 0.85,
  "rationale": "The columns cohere around a single inferable focus: characterizing the substance and attention-worthiness of each goal. They form a sound multi-faceted structure spanning what (outcome domain, targeted scope), how (mechanism), significance (scope breadth), rigor/specification (timeline clarity, financial quantification), and effort/risk (complexity). This is neither a single restatement nor generic noise, and the facets are data-inferable from description/dates/metric fields. Minor deductions: goal_outcome_domain and targeted_improvement_scope are near-duplicates (identical observed counts suggest parallel derivation, weakening differentiation), and execution_complexity_estimate is a somewhat coarse/derived judgment. The implied focus is genuinely actionable — an analyst could triage goals by significance, rigor, and complexity to decide what merits attention."
}
